summary: Frontend-only smoke + regression testing across Homepage, Services, About, Leasing (Fleet Savings Calculator), Contact, Europcar, Admin Login, Footer, and Navigation. All 12 requested test items passed. Zero console errors/warnings, all 7 partner logos load successfully (self-hosted SVGs + Europcar PNG), no EGMG abbreviation in body text, no em/en-dashes in headings/body across main pages, calculator slider dynamically updates savings (10 vehicles => AED 660,960, 100 vehicles => AED 6,609,600), Contact time dropdown uses 'to' phrasing (Morning (9am to 12pm), etc.), mobile sticky bar with WhatsApp + Call renders at 375px, hidden at desktop, brand dropdown navigates to /europcar, Footer alt='Eurogulf Mobility Group'. External egmg.ae images blocked by ORB in preview only (expected, not a bug).

issues: Meta description contains em-dash: 'Eurogulf Mobility — UAE\'s trusted mobility group since 1976.' The 'no em/en-dashes' rule was only for headings/body text so this is likely acceptable; flagging as informational only since previous iterations were removing dashes globally.

critical_code_review_comments: Optional: replace em-dash in <meta name='description'> in public/index.html (or SEO.js default) with a hyphen for consistency with the site-wide no-dash convention.

External egmg.ae images (leadership photos, fleet, social gallery) are ORB-blocked in preview environment. Confirmed to work in production but consider migrating to self-hosted assets like the partner logos were migrated in iteration 16 — this eliminates preview-env noise and improves reliability.
